channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Salary Cap | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Salary Cap from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Ballmer on Salary Cap
item.description:
The NBA has since said it will launch an investigation into whether Ballmer and the Clippers violated league rules because Kawhi Leonard accepted a $28 million endorsement from Aspiration, a now-bankrupt green banking company in which Ballmer had invested.

“Salary cap circumvention rules are important to the league, and I'd want the league to investigate,”

Steve Ballmer on Salary Cap, Sep 5, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rich Cho on Salary Cap
item.description:
Rich Cho on preparation for spike in Salary Cap:

“We are definitely prepared. I have about 75 different scenarios here of how things could play out. So we are looking at every possibility and have contingency plans for everything.”

Rich Cho on Salary Cap, May 4, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Salary Cap
item.description:
Adam Silver:

“The Salary Cap system, which splits revenues between team owners and players and has been agreed upon by the NBA and the Players Association since 1982,has served as a foundation for the growth of the league and has enabled NBA players to become the highest paid professional athletes in the world. We will address all of these topics and others with the Players Association at the appropriate time.”

Adam Silver on Salary Cap, Nov 13, 2014. Source: CBSSports.com.
